info.title: nlm-matched-clean
info.subtitle: use it to identify which llm generated the text
info.description:
37k de-duplicated passages from public Name That LLM generation datasets

`nlm_pool_v2.parquet`: 37,252 passages (`text`, `model`, `prompt_key`, `src`) written by the 18 competition models under the
competition's own protocol (single user message, *"Write a single paragraph of about N words"*), used as stage-1 data for the two-stage LoRA models and as extra data for the n-gram SVM. `nlm_matched_clean.parquet` is an earlier, smaller version.

Cleaning: exact and near-duplicate removal, removal of any text present in the official train set, chat/trace/benchmark-style corpora dropped
(they hurt), and passages dropped if they use a typographic mark their labelled model never uses in train.

Compiled from these public Kaggle datasets, all credit to their authors: 

willrice/name-that-llm-openrouter-harvest, seyitkaangunes/ntl-extra-api-passages,
lxdlxdlxd/ntl-synth-generations-v1, prvsiyan/prvsiyans-extended-name-that-llm-dataset, michaelsemenoff/ntl-own-extra-v1,
alperen5252525/ntl-vertex-gemini-proxy-gpt-generations, sunny114514/ntl-mega-corpus, ziyuzhou1207/ntl-zz-proxy-generations,
dophuchung/ntl-proxy-generations, haileycheng/name-that-llm-same-prompt-passages, lucasboesen/ntl-free-proxy-generations,
kaplinskiy/ntl-gpt-proxy-passages, prvsiyan/ntl-own-prompt-generations-v1, abdullah1afify/ntl-generations, keshavatearth/ntl-gpt-new-prompts-v1;
plus ~1.1k passages we generated through the Kaggle Benchmarks model proxy. 
Upstream licences apply to their rows (`src` column).
